articles.title: NH Foods (TSE:2282) Q2 Results Expose A Sharp Profit Squeeze
articles.summary: NH Foods just dropped its Q2 2027 results into a market that priced the stock at ¥2,082.5 coming into the release, with only a modest gain over the past quarter. The spotlight issue is profit pressure, not sales volume. Revenue for the quarter was ¥384,412m while net income excluding extra items came in at ¥6,622m, which keeps already thin trailing net margins near 1.9%.
